summary: Ilocos Sur 2nd District representative with about 93 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant record is all taxation: a taxpayer Magna Carta, a one-time tax amnesty, automatic fuel excise suspension, and co-authored income-tax restructuring and MCIT abolition. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Taxation is a single issue, so economic is not scored. Extractor may under-report.
